biggest_catch: No annual fee, so the net math is clean: 70,000 Hilton Honors points (worth roughly $350 at ~0.5 cent each) plus a Free Night Reward for $2,000 of planned spending in six months — a straight ~$350+ net before the free night's value. But this is a LIMITED TIME offer ending 1/13/2027, and you must apply through the offer page before then.
catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $2,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.
No annual fee, so the fee doesn't eat the bonus — net is roughly $350 in points plus one free night at the full offer.
This is a limited-time offer ending 1/13/2027 — apply through the offer advertisement before then or the terms may change.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.
Once-per-lifetime rule: you can only earn this card's welcome bonus once — not eligible if you have or have had this card.
Amex's eligibility check can deny the welcome offer based on your Card Member history and number of cards opened/closed; you are notified before processing so you can withdraw.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full.

Fees, interest, cash advances, gift cards, prepaid reloads, and person-to-person payments don't count toward the $2,000 threshold; account must not be past due or cancelled at fulfillment; bonus points don't count toward Hilton elite tier qualification.

steps: Open the official offer page https://www.americanexpress.com/us/credit-cards/card/hilton-honors/26129/ and apply before the 1/13/2027 offer end date — apply through this offer advertisement to get these terms.
If Amex shows a no-bonus eligibility pop-up during the application, withdraw before the hard inquiry.
If approved, spend $2,000 on purchases you were already planning within the first 6 months of Card Membership.
Pay the balance in full every month.
Keep the account open, not past due; the 70,000 points post to your Hilton Honors account 8-12 weeks after you hit $2,000, plus the Free Night Reward.
Use the points and free night for Hilton stays (points are worth roughly 0.5 cent each toward Hilton redemptions).
